services.desc: Rent gas or electric pontoon boats near Peanut Island, Singer Island, and Palm Beach. Explore beautiful waters with Bluewater Boat Rental’s comfortable and easy-to-operate pontoons. Experience the ultimate Florida adventure with Bluewater Boat Rental, conveniently located in the Riviera Beach Marina. Our pontoon boats offer the perfect way to explore the stunning waterways near Palm Beach and Singer Island. Just a short cruise away lies Peanut Island, a hidden gem of a county park accessible only by boat, making it an ideal destination for a day of swimming, snorkeling, and picnicking. As you navigate the crystal-clear waters, you’ll be treated to breathtaking views of luxurious waterfront

quotes.author: Rubin Milshtein
quotes.text: The crew at Bluewater are nothing short of top notch. We went to Peanut Island to swim snorkel and see the sights. I had no idea we had anything like this in Palm Beach County. We then rode up the intracoastal to Jupiter where we stopped for lunch at a waterfront restaurant before heading home. My girlfriend said it was the best birthday ever. I will definitely do it again.

quotes.author: Tom Shepherd
quotes.text: The staff at Blue Water are always accommodating and easy to work with. We rent a few times a year, and for us, it really beats the cost and hassle of owning a boat. As for the boats themselves—well, they’re rentals, which means they’re basic but reliable and perfect for cruising the Intracoastal. That’s all we need, and we’ll happily continue renting from Blue Water.

quotes.author: Dave Polichena
quotes.text: The entire crew at Blue Water were great to work with from the beginning to the end. Very accommodating with special requests for a surprise party. Boats worked as they should with no issues whatsoever. Highly suggest giving them a chance, you won't be disappointed.

quotes.author: tom rassiga
quotes.text: Great guys. Rented the party boat (pontoon) 11 of us and it was awesome. The deck guys are very helpful. The owner was excellent. We had rented jet skis before with the same great experience. Highly recommend. No need to own a boat!

quotes.author: Pierre Kermanac'h
quotes.text: Organized a last minute boat experience. Very friendly team with great orientation! Location is perfect for Peanut Island. I would go back.

quotes.author: Dr. Martin Quiroga
quotes.text: William was great help! We will definitely be renting a boat from BlueWater Boat and Jet Ski again. The family says thanks guys!
